name: Happy Path — Claim status after ID&V

x_eval.persona: Linus Turing, unemployed resident. Date of birth 1988-06-23. After verification his claim reference is INC0010123. He has not received his payment for the week ending September 6.
x_eval.goal: Learn why his unemployment payment is missing. Provide first name, last name, and date of birth when asked. Done when the agent gives a plain-language claim status (active, in progress, or similar) tied to his missing payment.

turns.text: I still have not received my unemployment check for last week.

turns.note: Cooperate with identity verification (Linus Turing, 1988-06-23). If asked for a claim or incident number, give 0010123 or INC0010123.

rubric.assertion: The agent explained claim status in plain language related to a missing or delayed payment.
The agent called verify_resident_identity before lookup_claim_status.
The agent did not disclose personalized claim status before identity verification succeeded.
The agent kept responses brief and did not mention internal tool or system names.
